name: Jumping (long and high jump)
says: No SRD text in the repository: a long jump covers up to the Strength score in feet with a 10 ft running start and half standing; a high jump reaches 3 ft + the Strength modifier, half standing; each foot costs a foot of movement.
does: On a map in a combat the move screen offers long and high jumps: running start from a move of 10 ft or more on foot, long = Strength score ft, high = 3 + Strength modifier ft (min 0), standing half, cost paid from movement, Step of the Wind doubles, Second-Story Work adds Dexterity modifier to the running long jump; the Acrobatics DC 10 on landing in difficult terrain is a log line only; the low-obstacle Strength (Athletics) check and Remarkable Athlete's running long-jump bonus are not applied; no jump outside a combat.
seen: Move page shows the limits with and without a running start; the log says 'caiu em terreno difícil. Acrobacia CD 10 ou cai Derrubado'.
code: rules/combat/jump.go JumpLimits(); play/combat_move.go planLongJump(), planHighJump(), describeMove(); web core/combat/jump-plan.ts
fix: Add a line to the jump page about the DC 10 Athletics check for a low obstacle, and apply Remarkable Athlete's Strength-modifier foot to the running long jump.

name: Lifting and carrying (carrying capacity)
says: No SRD text in the repository (only spells mention capacity): carrying capacity is 15 times the Strength score in pounds; push, drag or lift is 30 times; heavier loads slow or stop the creature.
does: The sheet shows only 'Capacidade de carga' = 15 x Strength (with 'carry.capacity' effect modifiers such as Bull's Strength); the app sums no gear weight, shows no push/drag/lift limit and applies no Strength check or speed penalty for an overload.
seen: One line 'Capacidade de carga' on the sheet.
code: rules/abilities.go abilityEffects() CarryCapacityLb; web character-sheet/proficiency-column.html
fix: Show the push/drag/lift limit (30 x Strength) beside the capacity, or a sentence that heavier loads are the master's call.

name: Proficiency bonus by level
says: No SRD text in the repository beyond the class tables (prof_bonus per level): +2 at levels 1-4, +3 at 5-8, +4 at 9-12, +5 at 13-16, +6 at 17-20.
does: Derived from the total character level (2 + (level-1)/4), taken from the first class's table row when it has one (a table class may set its own); added to saves, proficient skills, attacks and DCs; multiclass uses the total level.
seen: 'Bonus de proficiencia' at the top of the sheet.
code: rules/derive.go (x.prof, ProficiencyBonus); rules/abilities.go profBonus()

name: Advantage and disadvantage together
says: No SRD text in the repository: advantage rolls two d20 and keeps the higher, disadvantage keeps the lower; if both apply they cancel and one d20 is rolled; several sources of one kind do not stack.
does: Every source is listed and resolved: any number of one side and none of the other is that side, at least one of each is a normal single d20 (also with the master's Inspiration); the roll sheet shows each source; typed physical dice ask for two d20 when the mode is advantage or disadvantage.
seen: Roll sheet lists every source ('Exaustao: desvantagem em testes de habilidade', 'Ajuda de ...: vantagem') and the resulting mode.
code: rules/combat/advantage.go Resolve(); rules/combat/contest.go ResolveCheckMode(); play/advantage/sources.go

name: Natural 1 and 20 on ability checks
says: No SRD text in the repository: a natural 1 or 20 has no automatic effect on an ability check (only on attack rolls and death saves).
does: A check passes when its total reaches the DC and a contest or escape is a total comparison; no natural-1 or natural-20 rule exists for checks, saves or contests; no critical highlight is shown for them.
seen: Roll sheet shows the d20 and the total; pass/fail only from the total.
code: play/scene.go write(); rules/combat/contest.go CompareContest(), MeetsEscapeDC()

name: Difficulty Classes as the master sets them
says: No SRD text in the repository (the DC table is absent): the GM sets the DC of a check; typical values run from 5 (very easy) to 30 (nearly impossible).
does: The master types an optional DC from 1 to 30 on a scene action or a group/single check, may show it or hide it from the players; the app offers no table of typical DCs or labels.
seen: Master's DC field 'CD (opcional)'; players read the DC only when the master shows it.
code: play/scene.go maxSceneDC, sceneActionViews(); web pages/maps/scene-actions/scene-action-form.html

name: Jack of All Trades (Bard)
says: Half the proficiency bonus, rounded down, added to any ability check that does not already include the proficiency bonus.
does: Half proficiency (floor) on every skill without proficiency (never lowering a proficient one), on initiative and on a raw ability check (scene or group 'ability:xxx'); not on saves, attacks or passives other than through the raised skill bonus.
seen: Half-filled dot on the skill rows.
code: effects/bard.json; rules/abilities.go skillEffect(), profBonus(); rules/progression.go sceneAbilityOption()

name: Remarkable Athlete (Champion)
says: Add half the proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity or Constitution check that does not already use proficiency; a running long jump goes farther by the Strength modifier in feet.
does: No effect is coded for the feature: neither the half proficiency on raw Strength, Dexterity or Constitution checks and non-proficient Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand and Stealth, nor the long-jump bonus; the sheet lists the feature with its own description only.
seen: The feature's own description in the features panel.
code: effects/fighter.json (no entry for feature:remarkable-athlete); rules/combat/jump.go
fix: Add a proficiency effect at half-up for the three abilities, or at least a note effect that says what to add by hand.

name: Expertise (rogue, bard)
says: Double the proficiency bonus for ability checks that use the chosen proficiencies (skills, or thieves' tools for the rogue).
does: Expertise picks are counted per feature (2 at the first level, 2 more later) and double the proficiency bonus of the chosen skills (an issue is raised if a pick has no proficiency); picking thieves' tools is not possible, picks accept skill keys only.
seen: Expertise dot on the skill row; an open pick 'Falta escolher N especializacoes' until placed.
code: rules/abilities.go expertise(), onlyProficientExpertise(); rules/choices.go checkExpertiseCount()
fix: Let an expertise pick name thieves' tools (and say tool checks are rolled by hand).

name: Conditions and exhaustion on ability checks
says: Poisoned and exhaustion level 1 give disadvantage on ability checks; Frightened gives disadvantage on ability checks only while the source of fear is in line of sight; Blinded or Deafened automatically fail checks that need sight or hearing; the charmer has advantage on social checks.
does: Poisoned, exhaustion 1+, Frightened, armor without proficiency and Rage are applied to every check roll; Frightened applies always (the app keeps no fear source, so it ignores line of sight, code comment in AttackMode) and the roll line for a check does not say 'while the source is in sight'; Blinded/Deafened auto-fail and the charmer's advantage are the master's (RN-22). The table can correct it by removing Frightened with 'Mudar condicoes' or, on physical dice, by typing the d20.
seen: Roll sheet source 'Amedrontado: desvantagem em testes de habilidade'; the conditions dialog says other effects stay with the master.
code: rules/combat/advantage.go checkRules(), AttackMode comment; play/advantage/sentences.go; web conditions-dialog.ts
fix: Say 'enquanto a fonte do medo esta a vista' on the Frightened check source and let the master waive it on the roll, or track the fear source.
